title: Cold Water Swim
hook: What if you dive into icy water?
banner:
WHAT IF YOU DIVE
IN ICE WATER

beats.line: Your cognition slows, feeling as if you're legally drunk.
beats.idea: Character plunges, mouth open, animated breath clouds puff out

beats.line: You start shivering, producing heat as core temperature falls.
beats.idea: Close‑up of arm showing blue lines tightening around vessels

beats.line: Your heart rate spikes as adrenaline floods your system.
beats.idea: Cartoon heart beating fast with a speedometer needle climbing

beats.line: Your skin vessels tighten, giving a sharp tingling feeling.
beats.idea: Character shivers, visible shaking and frosty breath, thermometer dropping

beats.line: You gasp and hyperventilate as cold shock hits.
beats.idea: Brain cartoon with gears slowing, a wobble effect on the character’s eyes

description: A quick visual guide to the body’s reaction when you plunge into cold water.

facts.claim: Cold shock triggers involuntary gasp and hyperventilation
facts.source: NIH – National Institute of Environmental Health Sciences, Cold Shock Response

facts.claim: Cold exposure causes peripheral vasoconstriction and tingling
facts.source: Mayo Clinic – Cold Exposure and Vasoconstriction

facts.claim: Cold water immersion can increase heart rate via adrenaline surge
facts.source: American Heart Association – Cold Water Immersion and Cardiovascular Response

facts.claim: Shivering generates heat as core temperature drops
facts.source: World Health Organization – Thermoregulation and Shivering

facts.claim: Cold water immersion can impair cognitive function, similar to intoxication
facts.source: NIH – National Library of Medicine, Effects of Cold Water Immersion on Cognitive Performance

topic: What happens if you swim in cold water?
